delta_in_topk.note: transitions i >= 2. signal_share = (projected energy - expected projected noise) / (total energy - total noise); valid ONLY for the bases built from bins <= t-1 (independent of the noise of bins t, t+1); bases that contain bin t (strict_level_bins_le_t) or t and t+1 (oracle) also capture the bins' own noise, so for them only 'raw' is meaningful (signal_share can exceed 1). Pooled = energy-weighted over transitions (per-transition ratios are unstable at high noise share).
